scripts.//-- setup --: One-time bootstrap: install deps, start local Postgres (:5434), apply migrations, start Mailpit (:8026). See docs/run-locally.md.
scripts.setup: pnpm install && pnpm dev:db:up && pnpm dev:db:migrate && pnpm dev:mail:up
scripts.//-- dev --: dev = frontend (:7777) + backend (:3001) in parallel. Needs dev:db:up first.
scripts.//-- db --: Local Postgres 17 in docker on :5434 (user/db water, app role water_app). Migrations live in backend/migrations.
scripts.dev:db:reset: docker compose down -v && pnpm dev:db:up && pnpm dev:db:migrate
scripts.//-- mail --: Mailpit catches all local email (verify, password reset, invites): SMTP :1026, web UI http://localhost:8026. The backend's dev default is MAIL_TRANSPORT=smtp → Mailpit; see docs/run-locally.md § Email.
scripts.//-- data --: Demo data. seed:examples = 3 invented catchments + 2 demo users (demo@ / analyst@example.com, password demo-password), works on any clone. seed:demo = seed:examples + the client workbooks in ../project-water-management-source/Original/ (needs Python + openpyxl, scripts/wbt-import/README.md).
scripts.//-- build --: Production builds: static frontend (frontend/build) and the Lambda bundle (backend/dist/lambda.mjs).
scripts.//-- test --: test = unit tests everywhere (no DB). test:backend:db needs dev:db:up; it migrates and uses the water_test database.
scripts.//-- e2e --: Playwright (Chromium), fully local. Needs dev:db:up; rebuilds the water_e2e database and starts its own backend :3101 + frontend :7801 (dev servers untouched). First time: test:e2e:install. See e2e/README.md.
scripts.//-- infra --: Terraform in infra/: credential-free fmt -check + validate + plan-only `terraform test` (mocked providers, tests/guardrails.tftest.hcl). Needs terraform (tfenv, infra/.terraform-version). Never plans against or applies to AWS; see infra/README.md.
